sturgeon_wipe_the_green_off_the_wall_foo: The wall is clear. The sturgeon will never know. Neither will the algae.
Wiped it spotless. Spotless water, spotted duck.
sturgeon_peer_at_the_armour_plates: Every plate present. Armour older than my family tree.
No chips. It has been through worse than a tank.
sturgeon_press_a_pellet_to_the_wall_for_: Hoovered it from the other side. It could have sucked my bill off.
Sturgeons eat like a drain. A very old drain.
sturgeon_lob_pellets_up_and_over_the_cop: Lobbed. Patter, patter, silence. Dinner is served in the dark.
Pellets down the well. The old fish will find them.
sturgeon_draw_the_old_one_along_the_wall: It took the whole song to cross the tank. Ancient and unhurried.
Led it a lap. It leads me on all the rest.
sturgeon_hold_a_flake_up_at_the_water_li: Came all the way up for a flake. Took thirty years of effort.
Rare sight. Up, snap, gone. Back to the floor.
sturgeon_race_it_down_the_wall_and_win: Won by a lap. It was not aware of the race.
Victory by walking. It never even clocked me.
sturgeon_draw_a_fish_in_the_breath_fog: Drew a fish. The fish looked at the fish. Neither impressed.
My art career begins in breath.
sturgeon_measure_it_in_wing_spans: Six wing spans and a bit. It keeps growing between counts.
Seven spans, if you count the tail it denies.
sturgeon_bow_to_the_ancient_one: Bowed. It turned its head three degrees. A great honour.
Respects paid. In this tank, the old fish is the landlord.
sturgeon_argue_for_the_blunt_nose: A prehistoric nose against a duck bill. The nose is older.
sturgeon_sing_the_old_one_a_slow_hymn: It stayed for the verse. Fell asleep at the chorus.
Low and long, like the fish. We both held it.
sturgeon_jump_back_from_the_rising_snout: Thirty years asleep, then it surges. Fair play.
sturgeon_walk_the_old_one_down_the_wall_: Two ducks, one fish, no agreement. It chose the middle.
Pulled from both ends. The old fish took neither.
sturgeon_trade_guesses_on_its_age_with_a: Two hundred, by consensus. The fish stayed silent. A good sign.
Settled on 'old'. The fish confirmed with a long blink.

sturgeon_wipe_the_green_off_the_wall_foo.label: Wiping the green film off the foot of the tank wall in long flat strokes from the left corner to the right

sturgeon_rake_the_leaves_off_the_top_wit.label: Raking the leaves off the top of the tank with a reed held over the coping, drawing them to the left corner

sturgeon_sweep_the_silt_cloud_off_the_vi.label: Sweeping a wing over the wall to follow and thin the brown cloud the sturgeon keeps rooting up along the floor

sturgeon_polish_the_wall_with_a_wing_cor.label: Polishing the wall with the tip of a wing in small circles until the cloudy patch at eye height clears

sturgeon_peer_at_the_armour_plates.label: Peering at the bony plates along the sturgeon's back as it rolls past the wall, looking for any chip or crack

sturgeon_shove_the_sunk_husks_along_with.label: Brushing the sunk pellet husks along the floor line with a wing so they do not pile at the left corner

sturgeon_knock_three_slow_at_the_wall_fo.label: Knocking three slow beats at the foot of the wall with his bill, the night bell the old fish has always known

sturgeon_press_a_pellet_to_the_wall_for_.label: Pressing one pellet flat to the wall with his bill while the long snout hoovers at it from the other side

sturgeon_lob_pellets_up_and_over_the_cop.label: Lobbing a wingful of sinking pellets up and over the coping so they patter down to the floor

sturgeon_draw_the_old_one_along_the_wall.label: Drawing a wingtip slowly along the foot of the wall so the sturgeon follows it from end to end at its own pace

sturgeon_pat_the_wall_where_the_snout_re.label: Patting the wall with the back of a wing where the sturgeon rests its snout, slow as a bedtime stroke

sturgeon_tap_the_ledge_for_the_floor_to_.label: Tapping a slow toe on the front ledge so the floor hums and the sturgeon turns toward the sound

sturgeon_hold_a_flake_up_at_the_water_li.label: Holding one flake pinched in his bill up at the water line until the old sturgeon rises all the way to the top for it

sturgeon_race_it_down_the_wall_and_win.label: Racing the sturgeon down the length of the wall at a brisk walk and winning by a full lap

sturgeon_hunt_the_old_one_through_the_da.label: Hunting along the wall in the dark for the sturgeon, bill bobbing at each shadow that might be armour

sturgeon_chase_the_shadow_along_the_floo.label: Chasing the long armoured shadow along the floor line with a wingtip, never catching up with it

sturgeon_waltz_the_ledge_at_its_pace.label: Waltzing very slowly along the front ledge, one step to each sweep of the old fish's tail

sturgeon_lean_on_the_left_pier_post.label: Leaning his shoulder against the left pier post while the old fish does the rounds

sturgeon_sulk_when_the_old_one_stays_dow.label: Sulking at the wall with his tail to the water because the sturgeon has not shown itself all evening

sturgeon_chip_the_frost_from_the_wall_fo.label: Chipping the frost from the foot of the wall with his bill so the sturgeon's long night is clearly seen

sturgeon_bow_to_the_ancient_one.label: Bowing deeply to the ancient fish as it glides by the wall, a long and formal bill-dip

sturgeon_present_the_old_one_to_the_dark.label: Presenting the old fish to the dark with a grand wing sweep along the wall, a ringmaster introducing a monument

sturgeon_argue_for_the_blunt_nose.label: Arguing with the sturgeon over whose nose is the nobler one, bill to snout against the wall
